summary: The proof is correct and complete. The halfspace-depth hypothesis places z0 in the level-alpha metronoid; the entropy minimization produces a strictly positive logistic selection for every relative-interior point; approximation and weak compactness extend the construction to boundary points while preserving domination, mass, projected barycenter, compact support, and log-concavity; and the affine-hull form of the Grunbaum inequality yields the claimed ambient halfspace bound. The cases alpha=1, zero-dimensional and proper affine supports, and positive boundary mass are handled correctly.
